title: ICAR Official YouTube Channel
description: Official videos from Indian Council of Agricultural Research covering crop production, post-harvest, and new agricultural technologies.

title: DD Kisan YouTube Channel
description: Doordarshan Kisan — India's dedicated agricultural TV channel. Videos on crop cultivation, market, weather, and farmer success stories.

title: Dr. PDKV Akola Agricultural University Videos
description: Videos on crop management, soil testing, and farming techniques relevant to Maharashtra farmers.
source: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth (PDKV), Akola

title: TNAU Agritech Portal
description: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University's Agritech portal — comprehensive crop guides, pest management, and agricultural advisories.

title: Farmer Portal (farmer.gov.in)
description: Official Indian government portal for farmers — schemes, advisories, market prices, weather, and agricultural services.
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India

title: ICAR-NRCS Soybean Research Resources
description: ICAR's National Research Centre for Soybean — information on soybean varieties, cultivation, and disease management.

title: NAFED Resources for Farmers
description: NAFED (National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation) — resources on cooperative marketing, price support, and FPO formation.

title: Find Your Nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK)
description: KVKs are government farm science centres providing free advisory, demonstrations, and training for farmers. Find your nearest KVK through ICAR.
